text: dsh-skill-mcp-panel 为 DSH Web 提供技能与 MCP 服务器管理界面，并附带统一命令行工具。用户可从主页侧栏进入整页面板，浏览、搜索、启停和迁移技能，或编辑 profile 中的 MCP 配置并测试连接；保存后由宿主热加载。随包的 dsh-panel CLI 覆盖面板操作，并支持跨 profile 更新。适合需要在 DSH 中集中管理技能与外部工具连接的用户；支持 DSH 0.2.x Web profile。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel manages Skills and MCP servers in DSH Web. Search, enable, disable or move Skills; edit MCP settings and test connections. A matching CLI covers panel operations and updates across profiles. For DSH Web 0.2.x users.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的功能「技能管理」：侧栏面板支持浏览和搜索技能、查看内容、启停、删除，并添加或批量迁移技能文件。
dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的功能「MCP 配置」：通过表单或原文编辑 Stdio、HTTP 服务器配置，并可测试连接；保存后由 DSH 热加载。
dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的功能「统一 CLI」：dsh-panel 命令提供 skill 与 mcp 子命令，覆盖面板管理能力，并能升级多个 profile 中安装的插件。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · dsh-skill-mcp-panel：DSH 插件：把**技能**与 **MCP 服务器**的管理搬进 DSH Web 的主页侧边栏——点左栏的「Skill / MCP」，中央主区直接切到整页面板（不是弹窗，也不是设置页里的 tab），改完即生效。随包附带统一终端命令 `dsh-panel`：面板能做的事命令行都能做，另外多一个跨 profile 升级。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · dsh-skill-mcp-panel：- 🗂️ **技能管理** —— 列表预览、搜索、工作区分栏与分组筛选、卡片展开查看全文、热启停 / 删除，支持 `.md` / `.zip` / 技能文件夹的添加与批量迁移
- 🔌 **MCP 服务器管理** —— 接管 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里的每一条 MCP 服务器（表单 + 原文），Stdio / HTTP 两种调用方式，支持测试连接，保存后由 DSH HMR 热加载
- 🧩 **整页面板** —— 与宿主内置「插件」页同一套槽位机制，点左栏即在中央主区切页，页面左上角另有「← 返回会话」
- ⌨️ **`dsh-panel` 命令行** —— `dsh-panel skill …` 与 `dsh-panel mcp …` 覆盖两个面板的全部能力
- 📦 **装上就能用** —— npm 与 Release tarball 安装的都是预构建产物

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · dsh-skill-mcp-panel：> **profile 提示**：`mcp` 子命令**必须**显式写 `--profile <name>`，且名字必须已存在——打错会被拒绝，不会新建 profile。`skill` 不按 profile 分家（技能按用户根 / 工作区存放），不需要该参数。不带 `--profile` 的 `dsh-panel update` 升级全部已安装本插件的 profile（`desktop` 由桌面应用独占，自动跳过）。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 安装：1. 安装本包，二选一（桌面端用户请在内置插件安装器中输入'...add'后面的内容）：

**方式一：GitHub Release tarball**（推荐，恒定指向最新版）

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel/releases/latest/download/dsh-skill-mcp-panel.tgz
   ```

这是**无版本号的稳定链接**：每次发版都同时上传别名 `dsh-skill-mcp-panel.tgz`（恒定指向最新版）与带版本号的
   `dsh-skill-mcp-panel-<版本>.tgz`，所以这条命令不随版本改。需要锁定具体版本时，把 `latest/download/dsh-skill-mcp-panel.tgz`
   换成 `download/v<版本>/dsh-skill-mcp-panel-<版本>.tgz` 即可。

**方式二：npm（预构建，插件市场同款通道）**

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 安装：```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-mcp-panel
   ```

> 两种方式都安装预构建产物，无需本地构建。也可以从 Git 安装（Git 来源的依赖默认禁止运行 prepare 构建脚本；若报
   > `git-hosted plugins build on install...`，把 pnpm 在上面打印的 key 加到 profile 目录 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
   > 的 `allowBuilds` 下再重跑）：
   >
   > ```bash
   > dsh plugin --profile web add github:Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel
   > ```

2. 重启网关

重启后刷新页面：左侧栏「插件」下面就是合并后的「Skill / MCP」一行——点它把中央主区切成面板，面板内部再用页签切换「技能」与「MCP」。
dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 功能：面板和宿主自带的「插件」页是同一套机制：左栏一行「Skill / MCP」，点它把中央主区切过去——不是设置页的 tab，也不是弹窗。面板内用页签切换「技能」与「MCP」，并记住你上次停在哪一页；左上角「← 返回会话」随时退回进面板前的会话。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 技能面板：- **列表与卡片** —— 按名称搜索，点开卡片看全文；按工作区（全局 / 各工作区）分栏，可按分组或按来源筛选
- **启停与删除** —— 开关热生效（改的是磁盘上的 `SKILL.md`），删除可撤销；插件自带的技能可一键隐藏
- **添加** —— 点「+」或直接把文件 / 压缩包 / 技能文件夹拖进页面：`.md`、`.zip`、整个文件夹都认，含多个技能的文件夹一次导入；不合法、**目标作用域内**重名的逐条跳过并说明原因
- **迁移** —— 批量复制或移动到多个工作区，单条失败不影响其余
- **分组** —— 新建 / 重命名 / 删除、批量勾选成员；只写插件自己的显示配置，不动技能目录

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP 面板：- **服务器管理** —— 支持 **Stdio** 与 **HTTP** 两种方式：新增、编辑、启停、删除、测试连接；保存后由 DSH HMR 热加载，不用重启网关。文件里每一条 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 都能操作（不区分受管块内外，也不看 id 前缀）。表单改常规项并保留还没做成表单的字段；**原文**按字节改这一条。非 MCP 的行（含块内别人的条目）仍然逐字节保留
- **密钥** —— `env` / `headers` 在页面与 RPC 里脱敏，编辑时留空即保留旧值；值里写 `${NAME}` 就是读该环境变量
- **单工具禁用** —— 按工具名关掉其中一部分，被禁的工具会从模型看到的工具表里**消失**（不是调用时才拒绝），上下文立刻省下来
- **OAuth 登录** —— 远程 `streamable-http` 服务器支持时一键登录（按 RFC 8414 / OIDC / RFC 9728 逐级发现授权服务器，兼容带路径端点；动态注册客户端、授权码 + PKCE + RFC 8707 resource），令牌写回该行配置并热加载；可随时断开

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · DSH 版本兼容：只支持 **DSH `0.2.x`**（peer 声明 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`）。DSH 会在安装时和 profile 启动时校验这条声明，不满足就拒绝加载并打印精确豁免命令——不会静默崩。上界写成 `<0.3.0-0` 是因为该校验带 `includePrerelease`，`<0.3.0` 会把 `0.3.0-rc.1` 也放进来。

确需在老宿主上使用，用宿主打印的精确版本豁免：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web allow-version dsh-skill-mcp-panel@2.3.7 --dsh-version <宿主版本> --accept-risk
```

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 命令行：统一父命令为 `dsh-panel`。

> **全局 shim**：宿主启动时会在 npm 全局 bin 目录写入 `dsh-panel`。Windows 下写三份——`dsh-panel.cmd`（CMD）、`dsh-panel.ps1`（PowerShell）、以及**无扩展名**的 `dsh-panel` sh 脚本（Git Bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin 靠它，v2.1.5 之前缺这一份，bash 里会报 `command not found`）；macOS / Linux 写一份可执行的 `dsh-panel`。三份都指向「最后启动的那个 profile」装的插件副本。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 命令行：`mcp` 子命令**必须**用 `--profile <name>` 指定目标 profile，名字必须已存在（判据是
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json`）。打错名字会以退出码 2 被拒绝，**不会**像 `dsh plugin`
那样顺手新建一个 profile。`skill` 子命令**不需要** `--profile`——技能按用户根 / 工作区存放，不按
profile 分家。`dsh-panel update` 不带 `--profile` 时升级全部已安装本插件的 profile。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · profile 概览：```bash
dsh-panel profiles        # 每个 profile 的已装版本 / bundles 挂载情况 / 安装 spec
```

输出的第一行是**当前 dsh-panel 入口**的路径与版本。这条信息是必要的：`dsh-panel` 是全局单例 shim，
由最后启动的那个 profile 写入（`src/global-shim.ts`），因此它与表中任何一行都没有必然关系。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 技能子命令：```bash
dsh-panel skill --help

dsh-panel skill list                                  # 列出技能（含工作区：全局 / 工作区）
dsh-panel skill add <path>                            # 添加到全局（.md 文件、目录束或 .zip 压缩包）

技能文件**全局共享**（`~/.dsh/skills` 与 `<工作区>/.dsh/skills`），不按 profile 分家，所以
`skill` 子命令不需要 `--profile`。可选地加上它，会顺便确认该 profile 存在，并在它没把本插件
挂进 `dsh.profile.bundles` 时提醒你「这个 profile 看不到面板」。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP 子命令：```bash
dsh-panel mcp list [--ids] --profile web
dsh-panel mcp add --name <serverName> --stdio --command <cmd> [--args <arg> ...] [--env KEY=VALUE ...] [--cwd <path>] --profile web
dsh-panel mcp add --name <serverName> --http --url <url> [--header KEY=VALUE ...] --profile web
dsh-panel mcp enable|disable <serverName> [--id <entryId>] --profile web

环境变量取值直接写 `${NAME}`（保存时格式化成 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `!!js` 表达式，由 DSH 装载时求值）；以 `!!js` 开头的值按进阶写法原样透传：

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP 子命令：```bash
dsh-panel mcp add --name github --stdio --command npx --args -y --args @modelcontextprotocol/server-github \
  --env 'GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN}' --profile web

dsh-panel mcp add --name web --http --url https://example.com/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization=Bearer ${MCP_TOKEN}' --profile web

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 进阶：整段 JS 表达式原样写进 !!js 标签：dsh-panel mcp add --name web2 --http --url https://example.com/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization=!!js `Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`' --profile web
```

```bash
dsh-panel mcp add --name github --stdio --command npx --args -y --args @modelcontextprotocol/server-github \
  --env 'GITHUB_TOKEN=!!js process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN' --profile web

dsh-panel mcp add --name web --http --url https://example.com/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization=!!js `Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`' --profile web
```

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 进阶：整段 JS 表达式原样写进 !!js 标签：同名的两条（`serverName` 重复）不能直接按名字操作：`dsh-panel mcp list --ids` 会打出每条的 `entryId`，

文件里原本就有重名时面板不会拒绝保存，只拒绝**新增**重名。受管块由
`# >>> dsh-skill-mcp-panel:mcp:begin` / `# <<< ...end` 标记；块里**不是** MCP 的行请勿手改语义。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 更新插件：```bash
dsh-panel update                          # 升级全部已安装本插件的 profile
dsh-panel update --yes                    # 同上，不询问
dsh-panel update --profile web            # 只更新 web
dsh-panel mcp update                      # 等价于 dsh-panel update

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 更新插件：- 对比基准是**每个 profile 自己 `node_modules` 里已装的版本**，不是正在执行的那份 CLI 的版本。
- 更新**保持该 profile 原本的安装渠道**：tarball 装的仍走 tarball（换成对应版本的版本化 URL），npm 装的仍走 npm 并钉到该版本，
  Git（或来源未知）装的仍用 `github:Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel#v<版本>`。
- 已经是最新的 profile 会被跳过，不会被重装。
- `desktop` 由 DSH 桌面应用独占，宿主的 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 会直接报错；自动枚举时跳过并说明，
  显式 `--profile desktop` 时以退出码 2 报错。
- 更新完成后：客户端 bundle 热更新（刷新页面即可），服务端改动需要重启对应 profile 的网关。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 更新插件：CLI 只扫描当前目录锚定的项目根与用户根；管理其他工作区的技能请加 `--cwd <工作区路径>`。
同名技能存在于多个作用域时，`enable`/`disable`/`delete` 需加 `--global`/`--project`/`--workspace` 指定操作哪一份。
`add` 不在此列：目标作用域内没有同名就照常添加，跨作用域同名只打印一条提示（v2.1.7）。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 技能部分：页面和 `dsh-panel skill` 命令的每次操作，最终都是对磁盘上技能文件（`SKILL.md`）的改动，DSH 自带的文件监听器立刻发现变化——所以启用/停用、增删、迁移都热生效，无需重启网关。

- 技能实体直接存放在其工作区的技能文件夹：全局 = `~/.dsh/skills`，工作区 = `<工作区>/.dsh/skills`，没有隐藏存储或联接点——卸载插件后技能仍是普通文件，照常被 DSH 发现
- 停用 = 把 `SKILL.md` 改名为 `SKILL.md.disabled`，启用 = 改回来
- 改变所属位置 = 真实地把文件复制/移动到目标位置的文件夹（先校验、失败回滚）
- 随部署附带的技能（bundled）为只读，不可停用或删除

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP 部分：负责维护 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里每一条 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`；真正连接和注册工具的是 DSH 官方插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client，由 DSH 的 HMR 自动加载。

OAuth 发现按「RFC 9728 路径形态 PRM → 根 PRM → RFC 8414 插入式 AS → 根 AS → OIDC → 旧行为兜底」的顺序尝试，带路径的端点共 8 个候选（只有 origin 时去重为 3 个）；命中 PRM 后再解析 `authorization_servers[]`，并用 PRM 声明的 issuer 精确校验 AS 元数据。授权 URL 与 token 请求都带 RFC 8707 的 `resource`（优先 PRM 声明的同源值，否则取 MCP 端点 URL），兼容 Ardot 的 `invalid_target` 校验。失败时错误会列出已尝试的 URL 与每条的原因（404 / 超时 / issuer 不匹配），不再是笼统的「没有暴露发现文档」。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · 开发：源码为 TypeScript，位于 `src/`；编译产物 `lib/*.js` 随仓库一起提交（保证 Git 直装可用）。
改完源码后运行 `pnpm build`：`tsc` 编译到 `lib/` 并剥离浏览器束的多余模块标记。
发布时 `npm pack` 会通过 prepack 自动重新构建，无需手工编译。

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · dsh-skill-mcp-panel：A DSH plugin that brings **skill** and **MCP server** management into the DSH web home sidebar — click Skill / MCP in the left column and the center main area switches to a full panel (not a modal, not a tab in the Settings dialog), and changes take effect immediately. The package also ships the unified `dsh-panel` command: everything the panels can do, plus cross-profile upgrades.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · dsh-skill-mcp-panel：- 🗂️ **Skill management** — list and preview installed skills, search, workspace split and group filters, expand a card to read the full content, hot enable/disable and delete, plus `.md` / `.zip` / skill-folder adding and batch migration
- 🔌 **MCP server management** — own every MCP server in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (form + raw YAML), with Stdio / HTTP transports, connection tests, and hot reload through DSH HMR after saving
- 🧩 **Full panels, not modals** — the same slot mechanism as the host's built-in Plugins page; clicking the left column swaps the center main area, and each panel carries a “← Back to session” arrow
- ⌨️ **The `dsh-panel` CLI** — `dsh-panel skill …` and `dsh-panel mcp …` expose everything the two panels can do
- 📦 **Works out of the box** — both the npm package and the Release tarball ship prebuilt artifacts

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · dsh-skill-mcp-panel：> **Profile note**: the `mcp` sub-commands **require** an explicit `--profile <name>`, and the name must already exist — a typo is rejected rather than creating a profile. The `skill` sub-commands are not split per profile (skills live under the user root / workspace), so they need no `--profile`. `dsh-panel update` without `--profile` updates every profile that has the plugin installed (`desktop` is owned by the desktop app and is skipped automatically).

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Install：1. Install the package (its bundle layer auto-mounts it — no config editing). Pick either:

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel/releases/latest/download/dsh-skill-mcp-panel.tgz
   ```

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Install：This is the **version-less stable link**: every release uploads both the `dsh-skill-mcp-panel.tgz` alias (always
   pointing at the latest build) and a versioned `dsh-skill-mcp-panel-<version>.tgz`, so this command never
   needs editing. To pin a specific version, swap `latest/download/dsh-skill-mcp-panel.tgz` for
   `download/v<version>/dsh-skill-mcp-panel-<version>.tgz`.

**Option 2: npm (prebuilt, same channel as the plugin marketplace)**

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Install：Then refresh the page: right below Plugins the left column lists a single merged **Skill / MCP** row — clicking it swaps the center main area to the panel, and tabs inside the panel switch between Skills and MCP.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Features：The panel works exactly like the host's built-in Plugins page: a single **Skill / MCP** row in the left column swaps the center main area to the panel — no Settings tab, no dialog. Tabs inside the panel switch between Skills and MCP and remember the page you left; **← Back to session** takes you back to where you were.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Skills panel：- **List and cards** — search by name and expand a card for the full content; split by workspace (global / each workspace) and filter by group or by origin
- **Enable, disable, delete** — the switch is hot (it renames `SKILL.md` on disk) and delete is undoable; skills shipped by plugins can be hidden with one checkbox
- **Add** — use "+" or drop files, archives or skill folders straight onto the page: `.md`, `.zip` and whole folders all work, and a folder holding several skills imports in one go; invalid items and same-name items **within the target scope** are skipped with a reason
- **Migrate** — copy or move skills in bulk to several workspaces; one failure never aborts the rest
- **Groups** — create, rename and delete groups and batch-check members; groups live only in the plugin's own display config, skill directories are never touched

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP panel：- **Server management** — **Stdio** and **HTTP** transports: add, edit, enable/disable, delete and test connections; saving is hot-reloaded by DSH HMR, no gateway restart. Every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row can be operated on, inside or outside the managed block, whatever its id. The form edits ordinary fields and keeps ones it does not model yet; **Raw** edits that one entry byte for byte. Rows that are not MCP servers (including foreign rows inside the block) stay byte-for-byte untouched
- **Secrets** — `env` / `headers` are redacted in the UI and in RPC, an omitted key keeps its old value, and `${NAME}` in a value reads that environment variable
- **Disable individual tools** — turn tools off by name; a disabled tool disappears from the model-facing tool list instead of being merely refused at call time, so the context saving is real
- **OAuth sign-in** — one click for a remote `streamable-http` server that supports it (RFC 8414 / OIDC / RFC 9728 discovery, dynamic client registration, authorization code + PKCE + RFC 8707 resource); the token is written back into that row and hot-reloaded, and it can be disconnected at any time

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · DSH version compatibility：Only **DSH `0.2.x`** is supported (peer declaration `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`). DSH checks that declaration at install time and again at profile startup, refusing to load and printing the exact-version exemption when it does not match — no silent breakage. The upper bound is `<0.3.0-0` because the check runs with `includePrerelease`, so `<0.3.0` would let `0.3.0-rc.1` through.

If you really need it on an older host, grant the exemption the host prints:

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · DSH version compatibility：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web allow-version dsh-skill-mcp-panel@2.3.7 --dsh-version <host-version> --accept-risk
```

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · CLI：> **Global shim**: at startup the host writes `dsh-panel` into the npm global bin directory. On Windows that is three files — `dsh-panel.cmd` (CMD), `dsh-panel.ps1` (PowerShell) and an **extension-less** `dsh-panel` sh script (what Git Bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin look for; without it bash says `command not found`, which is what v2.1.5 fixed); on macOS / Linux it is a single executable `dsh-panel`. All of them point at the plugin copy of whichever profile started last.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · CLI：The `mcp` sub-commands **require** an explicit `--profile <name>`, and the name must already exist (a profile is a directory with a `package.json` under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`). A typo exits with code 2 — it will **not** silently create a profile the way `dsh plugin` does. The `skill` sub-commands do **not** need it: skills live under the user root / workspace and are not split per profile. `dsh-panel update` without `--profile` updates every profile that has the plugin installed.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Profile overview：```bash
dsh-panel profiles        # installed version / bundle mount / install spec for every profile
```

The first line is the **current dsh-panel entry point** and its version. That matters: `dsh-panel` is a single global shim, written by whichever profile booted last (`src/global-shim.ts`), so it has no necessary relationship to any row in that table.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Skill sub-commands：```bash
dsh-panel skill --help

dsh-panel skill list                                  # list skills (with scope: global / workspace)
dsh-panel skill add <path>                            # add to global (.md file, bundle dir, or .zip archive)

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Skill sub-commands：Skill files are **shared globally** (`~/.dsh/skills` and `<workspace>/.dsh/skills`) and are not split per profile, so the `skill` sub-commands need no `--profile`. Passing it optionally confirms that profile exists and warns you when it has not mounted this plugin in `dsh.profile.bundles` (such a profile simply will not show the panels).

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP sub-commands：```bash
dsh-panel mcp list [--ids] --profile web
dsh-panel mcp add --name <serverName> --stdio --command <cmd> [--args <arg> ...] [--env KEY=VALUE ...] [--cwd <path>] --profile web
dsh-panel mcp add --name <serverName> --http --url <url> [--header KEY=VALUE ...] --profile web
dsh-panel mcp enable|disable <serverName> [--id <entryId>] --profile web

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP sub-commands：Write `${NAME}` in a value to read that environment variable (it is formatted into a `!!js` expression in `cordis.patch.yml`, evaluated by DSH at load time); a `!!js` prefix passes a raw JS expression through:

```bash
dsh-panel mcp add --name github --stdio --command npx --args -y --args @modelcontextprotocol/server-github \
  --env 'GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN}' --profile web

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP sub-commands：dsh-panel mcp add --name web --http --url https://example.com/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization=Bearer ${MCP_TOKEN}' --profile web

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · advanced: a raw JS expression, stored inside a !!js tag：dsh-panel mcp add --name web2 --http --url https://example.com/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization=!!js `Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`' --profile web
```

```bash
dsh-panel mcp add --name github --stdio --command npx --args -y --args @modelcontextprotocol/server-github \
  --env 'GITHUB_TOKEN=!!js process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN' --profile web

dsh-panel mcp add --name web --http --url https://example.com/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization=!!js `Bearer ${process.env.MCP_TOKEN}`' --profile web
```
section: advanced: a raw JS expression, stored inside a !!js tag

text: dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · advanced: a raw JS expression, stored inside a !!js tag：New MCP servers are appended to the managed block in the target profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Every existing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row — including hand-written ones, **with or without an `id`** — can be `enable`d, `disable`d and `remove`d, and `dsh-panel mcp raw` prints or `--set` replaces that one entry. Raw editing may change that entry's content but not its indentation or placement (an `insert` member cannot become a top-level entry), and comments that belong to neighbouring rows are never touched. Changes hot-reload while the gateway is online.
section: advanced: a raw JS expression, stored inside a !!js tag

text: dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · advanced: a raw JS expression, stored inside a !!js tag：Two rows sharing a `serverName` cannot be addressed by name alone: `dsh-panel mcp list --ids` prints each row's `entryId`, `--id <entryId>` targets exactly one of them, and `raw --set` can then rename one of them. A file that already contains duplicates is not blocked from saving — only **newly introduced** duplicates are rejected. The block is delimited by `# >>> dsh-skill-mcp-panel:mcp:begin` / `# <<< ...end`; leave non-MCP rows inside it alone.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Updating the plugin：```bash
dsh-panel update                          # update every profile that has the plugin installed
dsh-panel update --yes                    # same, without prompting
dsh-panel update --profile web            # update only web
dsh-panel mcp update                      # same as dsh-panel update

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Updating the plugin：- The comparison baseline is the version **each profile has installed in its own `node_modules`**, not the version of whichever CLI copy happens to be running.
- Updates **stay on the channel that profile was installed from**: a tarball install updates from the versioned
  tarball URL, an npm install updates from npm pinned to that version, and a git (or unknown) install keeps
  using `github:Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel#v<version>`.
- Profiles already on the latest version are skipped, never reinstalled.
- `desktop` is owned exclusively by the DSH desktop app — the host rejects `dsh plugin --profile desktop`; it is skipped with an explanation during an automatic sweep, and exits with code 2 when named explicitly.
- After an update: client bundles hot-swap (just refresh the page); server-side changes need that profile's gateway restarted.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Updating the plugin：The CLI only scans the cwd-anchored project roots and the user roots; add `--cwd <workspace-path>` to manage a different workspace's skills. If a skill name exists in several scopes, `enable`/`disable`/`delete` require `--global`/`--project`/`--workspace` to pick which copy to operate on.
`add` is not in that set: as long as the target scope has no skill of that name, adding one that already exists elsewhere succeeds and only prints a notice (v2.1.7).

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Skills：Every action in the page or via `dsh-panel skill` ends up as a change to the skill files on disk (`SKILL.md`), and DSH's own file watcher notices immediately — that is why enable/disable, add/delete and migration are all hot, with no gateway restart.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Skills：- A skill's entity lives directly in its workspace's skill folder: global = `~/.dsh/skills`, workspace = `<workspace>/.dsh/skills` — no hidden store, no junctions: after uninstalling the plugin the skills are plain files DSH keeps discovering
- Disable = rename `SKILL.md` to `SKILL.md.disabled`; enable = rename it back
- Changing where a skill lives = physically copying/moving the files into the target folder (validated first, rolled back on failure)
- Deployment-bundled skills are read-only: they cannot be disabled or deleted

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · MCP：The plugin maintains every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; the actual connection and tool registration are done by the official DSH plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, loaded automatically through DSH HMR.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Development：The source is TypeScript under `src/`; the compiled `lib/*.js` is committed with the repo (so git installs keep working).
After editing the source, run `pnpm build`: `tsc` compiles to `lib/` and strips the extra module marker from the browser bundle.
When publishing, `npm pack` rebuilds automatically through prepack — no manual compile step.

dsh-skill-mcp-panel README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skill-mcp-panel
```
